classes.name: Volitve poslancev v Državni zbor
classes.finest_note: Polling-station (volišče) workbooks since 2011; HTML archives by electoral unit (1992) and by electoral district (volilni okraj) from 1996 to 2008.
classes.note: 90 deputies (Ustava art. 80): 88 by list PR in 8 electoral units of 11 deputies each, every unit split into 11 districts (volilni okraji) in which one candidate of each list stands; Droop quota in the units and national remainder seats by D'Hondt, with a 4% national threshold since the 2000 constitutional amendment (3 seats' worth before). One deputy each of the Italian and Hungarian national communities is elected in two special units by Borda count. Counted here as 10 contests per election (8 units and 2 community units). Seats never go to by-elections: a vacancy passes to the next candidate on the list.

cadence.administered_by: Državna volilna komisija, with the electoral-unit and district commissions (VKVE, OVK)
cadence.locator: https://www.dvk-rs.si/fileadmin/user_upload/dokumenti/zakonodaja/ustava.republike.slovenije.pdf (81. člen: Državni zbor je izvoljen za štiri leta)
cadence.vacancy_rule: A vacant list seat passes to the next candidate of the same list (ZVDZ); the President may dissolve the Assembly and call early elections when no government is formed (Ustava art. 111, 117).

access.platform: Državna volilna komisija (dvk-rs.si): končni izid po voliščih
access.evidence: One workbook per election with every polling station's registered voters, ballots, and list votes, 2011 to 2022; the 2026 results are served by the commission's results application at dvk-rs.si/arhivi/dz2026.
Static result archives dz1992 (national and electoral-unit tables), dz1996, dz2000, dz2004, and dz2008 (national, unit, and district tables, plus the national-community seats).

classes.name: Volitve predsednika republike
classes.finest_note: Polling-station workbooks for 2017; results applications by district and station for 2022; HTML archives by electoral unit and district from 1997.
classes.note: Direct two-round election; a candidate needs a majority of valid votes, otherwise the two leading candidates meet in a second round (Ustava art. 103). Five-year term, at most two consecutive terms.

cadence.runoff_rule: A majority of valid votes elects; otherwise the two candidates with the most votes meet in a second round (Ustava art. 103, Zakon o volitvah predsednika republike).

cadence.vacancy_rule: On a vacancy the President of the National Assembly stands in and a new election is called (Ustava art. 106).

classes.note: Legislative referendums (Ustava art. 90; since 2013 only on a demand of 40,000 voters, and a law is rejected when a majority of valid votes is against and the votes against reach a fifth of all voters), constitutional referendums (art. 170), referendums on international associations (art. 3a), and consultative referendums (ZRLI). The JEK2 consultative referendum called for 24 November 2024 was revoked before the vote.

classes.name: Volitve članov občinskih (mestnih) svetov
classes.finest_note: By municipality and by its council electoral units as the municipal commissions report them; no central polling-station files.
classes.note: Councils of 7 to 45 members (ZLS): councils of 12 or more members by list PR with a preference vote, smaller ones by plurality in one- or multi-member units (ZLV). Councillors of the Italian and Hungarian national communities in the bilingual areas and of the Roma community in 20 municipalities (ZLS art. 39) are elected in separate contests at the same time and belong to this class (the 2015 Roma by-election in Grosuplje is on the commission's site).

classes.name: Občinski referendumi
classes.note: Municipal councils may call a referendum on a general act or other matter of the municipality (ZLS, applying ZRLI).
classes.disposition_reason: Called and run by each municipality, with results only in municipal gazettes; the State Election Commission does not compile them.

classes.name: Referendumi o ustanovitvi občin
classes.note: Consultative referendums the National Assembly calls in the areas of proposed new municipalities before it changes the municipal map (ZLS). Those of 2006 are on the commission's site; earlier rounds are not.

cadence.administered_by: Državna volilna komisija and the commissions of the referendum areas

access.evidence: The decrees calling the referendums and the reports on their results for 29 January and 9 April 2006.

classes.name: Volitve v svete samoupravnih narodnih skupnosti
classes.name_en: Councils of the Italian and Hungarian self-governing national communities
classes.note: Members of the Italian and Hungarian national communities elect the councils of their municipal self-governing communities, which form the two national self-governing communities (Ustava art. 64).
classes.disposition_reason: Held on the local-election day but run by the communities' own election commissions; the State Election Commission does not publish the results and no official compilation was found.

classes.name: Posredne volitve
classes.disposition_reason: Officers chosen by elected bodies, not by voters: the Prime Minister and ministers (National Assembly), the President of the National Assembly, Constitutional Court judges, the Ombudsman, and mayors' deputies and committee chairs by municipal councils.

classes.name: Izvolitev sodnikov
classes.disposition_reason: No judge is elected by voters: the National Assembly elects judges on the proposal of the Judicial Council (Ustava art. 130), and lay judges are appointed.

classes.name: Določanje kandidatov
classes.disposition_reason: Parties choose their candidates under their own rules (ZVDZ, ZLV); the state runs no primary and publishes no nominating vote.

classes.name: Volitve v zbornice in druge nedržavne organe
classes.disposition_reason: Run by the bodies themselves for their members (the Chamber of Agriculture and Forestry, professional chambers, universities, works councils); not public elections.

classes.name: Volitve v Skupščino Republike Slovenije 1990
classes.name_en: 1990 multiparty election to the three chambers of the Assembly
classes.note: First multiparty election, in April 1990: the Socio-Political Chamber (80 seats, list PR), the Chamber of Municipalities (80 seats, by municipality), and the Chamber of Associated Labour (80 seats, by workplace electorates). This Assembly adopted the 1991 Constitution and sat until the National Assembly was elected in 1992.
classes.disposition_reason: Not on the State Election Commission's site, whose archive starts with the 1992 National Assembly election; the 1990 returns were published by the Republic Electoral Commission in print, and no official digital copy was found.

classes.name: Volitve predsednika in članov Predsedstva Republike Slovenije 1990
classes.name_en: 1990 election of the President and members of the Presidency
classes.note: Direct election in April 1990 of the President of the Presidency (two rounds) and four members; the Presidency served until the first President of the Republic took office in December 1992.
classes.disposition_reason: Not on the State Election Commission's site (its archive starts in 1992); no official digital copy of the Republic Electoral Commission's 1990 report was found.

classes.name: Plebiscit o samostojnosti in neodvisnosti Republike Slovenije
classes.note: Plebiscite of 23 December 1990 on an independent and sovereign Slovenia.
classes.disposition_reason: Not in the State Election Commission's referendum archive, which starts in 1996; no official digital copy of the plebiscite commission's report was found.

classes.name: Volitve v Skupščino LRS/SRS in občinske skupščine, 1945-1986
classes.name_en: Assembly and municipal assembly elections of the People's and Socialist Republic, 1945-1986
classes.note: Single-list and, from 1974, delegate elections to the republic's assembly and to the municipal assemblies (občinske skupščine).
classes.disposition_reason: Delegate-system and single-list returns were printed in the period's gazettes and statistical yearbooks; no official digital publication was found.

classes.name: Volitve v jugoslovansko ustavodajno skupščino, narodno skupščino in zvezno skupščino
classes.name_en: Yugoslav state elections held in Slovenia, 1920-1986
classes.note: Elections of the Kingdom of Serbs, Croats and Slovenes and of Yugoslavia (Constituent Assembly 1920, National Assembly 1923-1938) and of the federal assemblies of 1945-1986, in which Slovenia formed constituencies.
classes.disposition_reason: State elections of Yugoslavia, published in the Kingdom's and the federation's printed election statistics; no official digital publication was found, and no successor authority publishes them.

classes.name: Volitve v deželne zbore in državni zbor (Reichsrat)
classes.name_en: Crown-land diet and Reichsrat elections before 1918
classes.note: The diets of Carniola, Styria, Carinthia, Gorizia and Gradisca, and Istria, and the Austrian Reichsrat, in which today's Slovenia voted.
classes.disposition_reason: Elections of the Austrian half of the monarchy; the archive counts them in Austria's census (census.at, reichsrat and kronland_landtage).
